info.title: APITCG
info.description:
Welcome to **API TCG**. The purpose of this API is to expose the card and product data of each TCG: games, sets/expansions, products (cards, sealed, accessories), market prices and price history. It covers **19 trading card games** and is refreshed every day. ![API TCG](./intro.png) ## Authentication All data endpoints require an **API key**. Getting one is free: 1. Create an account at [apitcg.com/register](https://apitcg.com/register) (or sign in at [apitcg.com/login](https://apitcg.com/login)). 2. Open the [Developer Platform](https://apitcg.com/platform) and go to **[API Key](https://apitcg.com/platform/api-key)** — your key is shown there. 3. Send it in the `x-api-key` header on every request: ```bash curl 'https://api.apitcg.com/api/products?tcg=one-piece&name=luffy' \ -H 'x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY' ``` JavaScript example: ```js const res = await fetch( 'https://api.apitcg.com/api/products?tcg=one-piece&name=luffy', { headers: { 'x-api-key': process.env.APITCG_API_KEY } } ); const body = await res.json(); ``` You can paste your key in the **Authentication** panel of this documentation to try endpoints live. Keep your API key secret. If it was exposed, regenerate it from the [API Key](https://apitcg.com/platform/api-key) page: the old key stops working immediately. ### Authentication errors | Status | `error` in the body | Meaning | |--------|------|---------| | `401 Unauthorized` | `API key is required, register into: https://apitcg.com/platform` | The `x-api-key` header is missing. | | `401 Unauthorized` | `Invalid API key.` | The key does not exist, or it was regenerated. | | `429 Too Many Requests` | `Request limit reached for this month.` | The monthly requests of your plan are used up. See [Plans and limits](#description/plans-and-limits). | | `429 Too Many Requests` | `Too many requests, slow down.` | More than 300 requests in a minute. Wait the seconds in the `Retry-After` header. | ## Plans and limits | Plan | Requests per month | Price | |------|-------------------:|------:| | Free | 1,000 | $0 | | Starter | 20,000 | $19 / month | | Pro | 200,000 | $99 / month | - Every request authenticated with your key counts once against your monthly requests, including the ones that answer with an error. - The counter goes back to zero on the 1st of each month at 00:00, Chile time (America/Santiago). - Follow your usage and change plans in the [Developer Platform](https://apitcg.com/platform/plans). Paid plans are billed monthly through PayPal. - On top of the monthly requests, each IP can make up to **300 requests per minute**. Every response carries the `RateLimit-Policy` and `RateLimit` headers (`limit`, `remaining`, and `reset` in seconds). Need more? Write to [support@apitcg.com](mailto:support@apitcg.com). ## Available TCGs | Name | Slug | |------|------| | Cardfight Vanguard | `cardfight-vanguard` | | Cyberpunk | `cyberpunk` | | Digimon | `digimon` | | Dragon Ball Super Fusion World | `dragon-ball-super-fusion-world` | | Dragon Ball Super Masters | `dragon-ball-super-masters` | | Final Fantasy TCG | `final-fantasy-tcg` | | Flesh and Blood | `flesh-and-blood` | | Gundam | `gundam` | | hololive | `hololive` | | Lorcana | `lorcana` | | Magic | `magic` | | Mitos y Leyendas | `mitos-y-leyendas` | | One Piece | `one-piece` | | Palworld | `palworld` | | Pokémon | `pokemon` | | Riftbound | `riftbound` | | Star Wars Unlimited | `star-wars-unlimited` | | Union Arena | `union-arena` | | Yu-Gi-Oh | `yugioh` | Use the **slug** as the `{tcg}` value in the routes (e.g. `/api/one-piece/sets`) and in the `?tcg=` filter for products. ## How to use Search products by combining filters, for example: ``` GET /api/products?tcg=one-piece&type=card&name=luffy ``` - `name` matches any part of the name and ignores case (`luffy` finds `Monkey.D.Luffy`). If nothing matches, a fuzzy fallback runs and the response includes `fallback: true`. - `code` is the exact card code (`OP03-070`), case-sensitive. - `set` takes the set `_id` (`one-piece-pillars-of-strength`), as returned by `/api/{tcg}/sets`. The `tcg` and `set` references come back as **full documents**, not as IDs — you do not need `populate` for them. The slug/ID of each one is its `_id`. ## Prices Products sold on TCGplayer carry their market prices in `markets.tcgplayer`, in US dollars: - `prices` — `low`, `mid`, `high` and `market` of the main printing. - `printing` — the printing those prices belong to (`Normal`, `Foil`, `Holofoil`, `Reverse Holofoil`, `1st Edition`…). The main printing is the first one with a market price, in that order. - `printings` — every printing TCGplayer sells for the product, each with its own prices. A price is `null` when TCGplayer has no data for it. ```json "tcgplayer": { "id": "253325", "prices": { "low": 0.02, "mid": 0.2, "high": 2.2, "market": 0.18 }, "printing": "Normal", "printings": [ { "subTypeName": "Normal", "prices": { "low": 0.02, "mid": 0.2, "high": 2.2, "market": 0.18 } }, { "subTypeName": "Reverse Holofoil", "prices": { "low": 0.1, "mid": 0.3, "high": 19.8, "market": 0.3 } } ] } ``` Prices are refreshed every day, and each day is kept in the price history of the product (`GET /api/history-prices/{productId}`), together with the printing of that day's prices. Mitos y Leyendas products do not carry prices. ## Product attributes Apart from the fixed fields (`name`, `images`, `markets`…), every product carries an `attributes` object: a map of strings whose **keys depend on the game**. A Lorcana card has `Cost Ink` and `Lore Value`; a Magic card has `OracleText`, `P` and `T`. Values may contain light HTML (``, ``, `
`), because that is how the source publishes them. Two keys are worth calling out: - **`Artist`** — on a `card`, the illustrator of the card. - **`Description`** — on a `card`, its rules text; on a `sealed` product, the description of the product (what the box contains, print run notes, etc.). ### Artist `attributes.Artist` holds the illustrator of the card. It is filled in progressively, so **not every card has it**: - **Games that publish the artist:** `cyberpunk`, `digimon`, `flesh-and-blood`, `gundam`, `lorcana`, `magic`, `one-piece`, `pokemon`, `riftbound`, `star-wars-unlimited`. - **Games that do not publish it:** `cardfight-vanguard`, `dragon-ball-super-fusion-world`, `dragon-ball-super-masters`, `final-fantasy-tcg`, `hololive`, `mitos-y-leyendas`, `palworld`, `union-arena`, `yugioh`. In `pokemon` the illustrator is checked every week against [TCGdex](https://tcgdex.dev), which fixes and completes what TCGplayer publishes. The card's TCGdex ID travels in `markets.tcgdex.id`. Even in the games that do publish it the coverage is not 100%, so treat `Artist` as an optional key: check for it before reading it. There is no `?artist=` filter — the field travels inside `attributes`. ### Sealed product descriptions `attributes.Description` on a `type: "sealed"` product is the description of the sealed product itself. Most of the sealed catalog already has it: ``` GET /api/products?tcg=pokemon&type=sealed&limit=1 ``` ```json { "_id": 50733, "type": "sealed", "name": "10th Movie Commemoration Set", "attributes": { "Description": "To commemorate the 10th Pokémon movie release in Japan, a special card album was released containing 11 cards…" } } ``` ## Pagination - `limit` — number of results per query (maximum `100`, default `25`). - `page` — the page you want to show of the total results. Example: `/api/products?tcg=pokemon&name=charizard&limit=50&page=2` `total` is the number of matching products. It is cached for up to a minute, so right after a sync it can lag slightly behind. ### Syncing the whole catalog To copy a large part of the catalog, page with a **cursor** instead of `page`: sort by `_id` and send the last `_id` you received as `afterId`. Stop when `data` comes back empty. In cursor mode `total` is `null`. ``` GET /api/products?tcg=pokemon&sortBy=_id&sortOrder=asc&limit=100&afterId=0 GET /api/products?tcg=pokemon&sortBy=_id&sortOrder=asc&limit=100&afterId=45728 ``` Afterwards, ask only for what changed since your last sync with `updatedSince` (ISO 8601): ``` GET /api/products?updatedSince=2026-10-01T00:00:00Z&sortBy=_id&sortOrder=asc&limit=100&afterId=0 ``` ## Data updates The catalog follows TCGplayer every day (Chile time, America/Santiago): | When | What | |------|------| | Daily, 00:00 | Sets: name, code and release date | | Daily, 00:10 | New and updated products | | Daily, 01:10 | Prices and price history | | Mondays | Card artists and sealed product descriptions | | Tuesdays | Pokémon illustrators from TCGdex | Set codes (such as `OP03` or `OGN`) are the set abbreviations published by TCGplayer. ## Showcase List of websites people are building with API TCG: 1. [tcgmatch.cl](https://tcgmatch.cl) 2. [Search Piece](https://search-piece.vercel.app/) Want to add your site? Open a pull request on [docs.apitcg.com](https://github.com/apitcg/docs.apitcg.com). ## Questions If you have any questions, you can write to: [support@apitcg.com](mailto:support@apitcg.com)

get.description: Checks that the API is up and returns version information.
Returns the list of registered trading card games. Each TCG's `_id` is its **slug**, used across the other routes.

total.description: Number of TCGs returned (this endpoint does not paginate).

get.summary: List the sets of a TCG
get.description: Returns all sets/expansions of the given TCG.

parameters.name: populate
parameters.description: If set to `tcg`, includes the full TCG document instead of just its ID.

200.description: List of sets for the TCG.

total.description: Number of sets returned (this endpoint does not paginate).

get.summary: Get a set by ID within a TCG
get.description: Returns a set by its `_id` within the given TCG.

parameters.name: populate
parameters.description: If set to `tcg`, includes the full TCG document.

get.description:
Returns products with combinable filters. `name` matches any part of the name; if nothing matches, a fuzzy fallback search kicks in and the response includes `fallback: true`.

The `tcg` and `set` references always come back as **full documents** — you do not need `populate` for them.

### Examples

- Search cards by name:

```
GET /api/products?tcg=one-piece&name=luffy
```

- Search by card code:

```
GET /api/products?code=OP03-070
```

- Cards of a TCG with pagination and sorting:

```
GET /api/products?tcg=pokemon&type=card&name=charizard&limit=50&page=2
```

- Sealed products of a TCG (their description travels in `attributes.Description`):

```
GET /api/products?tcg=riftbound&type=sealed
```

- The illustrator of a card is in `attributes.Artist`, when the game publishes it:

```
GET /api/products?tcg=lorcana&type=card&name=elsa
```

- Full catalog sync with the cursor (send the last `_id` as `afterId`):

```
GET /api/products?tcg=pokemon&sortBy=_id&sortOrder=asc&limit=100&afterId=0
```

See [Product attributes](#description/product-attributes) for what `attributes` carries and [Prices](#description/prices) for `markets`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by product type. The catalog currently holds `card` and `sealed` products.

parameters.name: tcg
parameters.description: Filter by TCG (slug — see the list of available TCGs).

parameters.name: set
parameters.description: Filter by set: the set `_id` (e.g. `one-piece-pillars-of-strength`), as returned by `/api/{tcg}/sets`.

parameters.name: serie
parameters.description: Filter by series (series ID). Series are not in use in the current catalog.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Search by name: ignores case and matches any part of the name (`luffy` finds `Monkey.D.Luffy`). If nothing matches, a fuzzy fallback runs and the response includes `fallback: true`.

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Only products updated since this date (ISO 8601). Combine it with `afterId` to sync only what changed.

parameters.name: afterId
parameters.description: Cursor for full syncs: only products whose `_id` is greater than this value. Use it with `sortBy=_id&sortOrder=asc` and send the last `_id` you received. In cursor mode `total` comes back as `null`. See [Syncing the whole catalog](#description/syncing-the-whole-catalog).

parameters.name: populate
parameters.description: Comma-separated references to include as full documents. Allowed values: `tcg`, `set`, `serie`. `tcg` and `set` already come populated by default, so in practice you only need this for `serie`.

total.description: Number of matching products, cached for up to a minute. `null` when you page with `afterId`.

fallback.description: Present and `true` only when the partial name fallback search was used.

get.description: Returns a product by its numeric (auto-incremental) `_id`.

parameters.name: populate
parameters.description: Comma-separated references to include as full documents. Allowed values: `tcg`, `set`, `serie`. `tcg` and `set` already come populated by default.

get.description:
Returns the daily price history of a product, newest first: one record per day, with that day's TCGplayer prices and the printing they belong to. An unknown product returns an empty array.

```
GET /api/history-prices/9804?from=2026-10-01&limit=30
```

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only records from this day on (ISO 8601, e.g. `2026-10-01`).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only records up to this day (ISO 8601).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Your personal API key from [apitcg.com/platform/api-key](https://apitcg.com/platform/api-key). Create a free account at [apitcg.com/register](https://apitcg.com/register).

TcgSlug.name: tcg
TcgSlug.description: TCG slug (see the list of available TCGs in the introduction).

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100).

SortBy.name: sortBy
SortBy.description: Field to sort the results by.

NotFound.description: Resource not found: `TCG no encontrado`, `Set no encontrado en este TCG` or `Producto no encontrado`.

value.error: API key is required, register into: https://apitcg.com/platform

TooManyRequests.description: The monthly requests of your plan are used up, or more than 300 requests in a minute from the same IP (wait the seconds in `Retry-After`).

value.error: Request limit reached for this month.

burst.summary: More than 300 requests in a minute

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait (only on the per-minute limit).

TCG.description: Trading card game. The `_id` is a slug generated from the name.

Set.description: Set/expansion within a TCG. The `_id` is composed as `{tcg}-{slug}`.

tcg.description: Slug of the TCG it belongs to (or the full document when using `populate=tcg`).

serie.description: ID of the series it belongs to (optional).

Product.description: Product resource. Fields marked (Card), (Sealed) or (Accessory) only apply to that product type. The catalog currently holds `card` and `sealed` products; fields marked _(not in use)_ exist in the model but the catalog does not fill them today.

type.description: Product type. The catalog currently holds `card` and `sealed` products.

description.description: Top-level product description _(not in use)_. The description of a sealed product travels in `attributes.Description`.

tcg.description: TCG the product belongs to. The API returns the **full document**; its `_id` is the slug (e.g. `one-piece`).

serie.description: Series ID (or the full document with `populate=serie`) _(not in use)_.

set.description: Set the product belongs to. The API returns the **full document**; its `_id` is the set ID (e.g. `one-piece-pillars-of-strength`). Absent or `null` when the product is not linked to a set.

dimensions.description: Physical dimensions of the product _(not in use)_.

release_date.description: Release date of the product _(not in use)_. The release date of the set is in `set.release_date`.

markets.description: Product data and IDs on external markets.

printing.description: Printing whose prices are in `prices`: the first one with a market price, in the order Normal, Unlimited, Holofoil, Unlimited Holofoil, Foil, Cold Foil, Rainbow Foil, Reverse Holofoil, 1st Edition, 1st Edition Holofoil, Limited.

printings.description: Every printing TCGplayer sells for the product, in the same order, each with its own prices.

tcgmatch.description: Reserved for TCGmatch (Chile) _(not in use in the current catalog)_.

tcgdex.description: (Pokémon cards) The card on [TCGdex](https://tcgdex.dev), the source of its illustrator.

cardNumber.description: (Card) Card number within the set. Only Mitos y Leyendas uses it; in the other games the number travels in `attributes.Number`.

attributes.description:
Dynamic attributes of the product. The keys depend on the game (see [Product attributes](#description/product-attributes)); values may contain light HTML.

- **(Card)** `Artist` — illustrator of the card, when the game publishes it.
- **(Card)** `Description` — the rules text of the card.
- **(Sealed)** `Description` — the description of the sealed product.

HistoryPrice.description: Daily price record of a product across markets.

date.description: Day of the record, at midnight UTC: read only the date part.

printing.description: Printing the prices of that day belong to.
